_note: The real floor, in the Lighthouse frame of calibration.yaml (metres, yaw degrees CCW). Use it with ARENA=manager/arena.floor.json. MEASURED: the net corners and the drone cage (drone squad, 2026-10-10, scout walked to the corners: (2.06,-0.71), (1.96,1.18), (-1.35,1.48); the 4th corner lost tracking, about (-1.25,-0.41) by symmetry). The drone cage is drone_server.py's DEFAULT_CAGE. PROVISIONAL until F1: bounds (net minus 0.1 m, widened to contain the drone cage), zones, home, overhead tags and camera position. Move them on the floor with the target Crazyflie as a wand and set calibrated:true. manager/arena.json stays the mock/test arena.
_view_note: view = what the dashboard map shows: the measured net corners (2.06,-0.71) (1.96,1.18) (-1.35,1.48) plus a margin, so a scout or rover outside the arena stays visible (the map also grows by itself). launch_pad = where the scout sits before takeoff; the drone server reports the real one (its first takeoff spot) once it has flown, so this is only the pre-flight guess. Measure it with the wand and fill it in.

overhead._note: PLACEHOLDER. Railing camera above one edge of the net, looking down at an angle. ArUco tags 0-3 (DICT_4X4_50) flat on the floor just outside the net corners; enter their measured centres. camera_floor_xy = the floor point straight below the lens (it may be outside the net), camera_height_m = lens height above the floor.
